tagline.zh: 相邻的元素被感知为一组:间距本身就是分组语法。组内间距小、组间间距大,关系不用一条线就成立。
tagline.en: Elements near each other are perceived as a group: spacing itself is grouping grammar. Tight inside, loose outside — relationships hold without a single line.

origin.zh: 格式塔心理学分组原则之一:相邻元素被感知为一组(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX;调研 07§31)。调研 07§31 同时列出格式塔分组五类:Proximity、Similarity、Continuity、Closure、Connectedness;指导:用间距建立元素间关系(表单字段分组、列表条目间距、搜索结果簇),邻近帮助用户更快理解与组织信息。
origin.en: One of the Gestalt grouping principles: elements near each other are perceived as a group (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX; research 07 §31). Research 07 §31 also lists the five Gestalt grouping laws — Proximity, Similarity, Continuity, Closure, Connectedness; guidance: build relationships with spacing (form field groups, list item spacing, search-result clusters).

effect.zh: 组与组之间的间距。默认 36px 对三组×4 元素的布局已明显大于组内;调到与组内间距相等时,分组感知崩解——「间距差」才是分组信号,不是绝对值。
effect.en: Spacing between groups. Default 36px clearly exceeds the intra-group gap for a 3×4 layout; equalize it with the inner gap and group perception collapses — the spacing *difference* is the grouping signal, not the absolute value.

effect.zh: 组内元素间距。默认 10px:与 36px 组间形成约 1:3.6 的对比;把 inner 拉大到接近 gap,三组会退化成 12 个散点。
effect.en: Spacing between elements inside a group. Default 10px: a ~1:3.6 contrast against the 36px group gap; drag inner up toward gap and the three groups dissolve into 12 scattered dots.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换布局)。uniform=所有间隙统一(对照组):同样的 12 个元素,没有任何分组感知——接近性的「阴性对照」。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo subscribes and swaps layout). uniform = one gap everywhere (control condition): the same 12 elements with zero group perception — proximity's negative control.

note.zh: 纯 CSS flex/grid 间距,全现代浏览器可用。
note.en: Pure CSS flex/grid gaps; all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 间距没有兼容性问题,工程红线是:分组信号不能只靠间距单通道——高风险分组(如「同时删除这组」)要叠加共同区域(边框/背景,见格式塔·共同区域原则)与语义分组(fieldset/列表,SC 1.3.1)。窄屏空间不足时优先保住「组间 > 组内」的差,必要时压缩绝对值。
fallback.en: Spacing has no compat issues; the engineering floor: never let spacing be the only grouping channel — high-stakes groups (e.g. 'delete this set together') stack Common Region (border/background) and semantic grouping (fieldset/lists, SC 1.3.1). On cramped narrow screens, protect the 'between > within' difference first, compressing absolute values if needed.

use.zh: 表单字段分组:相关字段靠近,组间留白
use.en: Form field grouping: related fields close, whitespace between groups

use.zh: 列表与搜索结果簇:条目内紧凑、条目间疏朗
use.en: Lists and search-result clusters: tight within items, airy between

use.zh: 卡片内元素层级:标题-正文-操作靠间距分层
use.en: In-card hierarchy: title/body/actions layered by spacing alone

avoid.zh: 全部等距的「均匀网格」承载本该分组的对象
avoid.en: Uniform all-equal spacing carrying content that needs grouping

avoid.zh: 只用间距表达强绑定操作(如批量删除组),不加容器或语义分组
avoid.en: Spacing-only signaling for strongly-bound actions (batch delete groups) without a container or semantics

a11y.zh: 视觉分组必须同时是语义分组:字段组用 fieldset/legend,相关列表用列表元素——读屏用户没有「间距」可感知(WCAG SC 1.3.1 信息与关系)。间距只服务视觉通道,语义通道要另行送达。
a11y.en: Visual grouping must also be semantic grouping: fieldsets with legends, real list elements for lists — screen-reader users cannot perceive 'spacing' (WCAG SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships). Spacing serves the visual channel; the semantic channel must deliver separately.

goal.zh: 做一个接近性对照实验:12 个元素排成 3 组×4,组间/组内间距两个滑块独立可调;另设「均匀网格」对照组;让用户亲眼看到间距差消失时分组感知崩解。
goal.en: Build a proximity experiment: 12 elements in 3 groups of 4 with independent between/within spacing sliders, plus a uniform-grid control; let the user watch group perception collapse as the spacing difference vanishes.

acceptance.zh: gap 与 inner 为 CSS 变量型参数(--gp-gap / --gp-inner),拖动即时生效
acceptance.en: gap and inner are CSS-var-type params (--gp-gap / --gp-inner), effective live

acceptance.zh: layout 为 JS 型参数:grouped 用两级间距,uniform 全部等距
acceptance.en: layout is a JS-type param: grouped uses two spacing tiers, uniform one gap everywhere

acceptance.zh: 元素内容保持不变,只有间距变化——隔离「间距」这一个变量
acceptance.en: Element content stays identical; only spacing changes — isolating the one variable

acceptance.zh: 面板标注当前 gap:inner 比值,提示分组感知的强弱
acceptance.en: The panel shows the current gap:inner ratio as a proxy for grouping strength

acceptance.zh: 分组语义同步:演示仅视觉;真实实现需 fieldset/列表等语义分组
acceptance.en: Semantic grouping noted: the demo is visual only; real code needs fieldsets/lists
